~/about

Built by developers.For developers.

  • Clean architecture

    Clear boundaries and small modules. Code that explains itself.

  • Developer experience

    Fast setup, honest docs, sensible defaults.

  • Performance

    Lean bundles and a fast first paint from day one.

  • Security

    Validated input, least privilege, no secrets in source.

  • Scalability

    Structured to grow from prototype to production.

  • Privacy

    Collect less. Protect what you keep.

  • Open standards

    Web standards and portable formats over lock-in.
